descriptionAboutMe: I am a Senior Software Engineer based in São Paulo with 10 years of experience in technology. I work with full stack development, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using Java, Spring Boot, Python, Node.js, React, Kafka, and Redis. I currently work at Dock on the Pix team, designing and evolving payment flows with TypeScript, Clean Architecture, AWS, Kubernetes, SQS, DLQ, CloudFormation, Lambda, and Datadog. Previously, I worked at Bradesco, Mercado Livre, Itaú, Cognizant, and Tech Mahindra across banking software, cloud platforms, test automation, and SRE. My current specialization includes LLMs, RAG, MCP, AI agents, and AI APIs.
professionalObjective: I aim to work in Software Engineering, Software Architecture, or Artificial Intelligence solutions, contributing to APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and applications based on LLMs, RAG, and MCP.
